subject: Endpoint tooling renewal — MDM, EDR, vulnerability scanner: scope, SOW, and procurement steps
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Jones <alex.jones@sentinelshield.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00Z
Subject: Renewal kickoff — endpoint stack (MDM / EDR / vuln) — request for SOW and pricing

Team,

Our current agreements with SentinelShield for device management (MDM), endpoint detection (EDR), and vuln scanning expire 2027-01-15. I had a call with Alex last week and he said they'd send an updated SOW and a pricing worksheet for our FY27 term.

Ask: can procurement and security confirm what minimum deliverables we need in the SOW (e.g., telemetry retention, agent support SLAs, licensing counts by seat/host)? I attached the previous SOW for context. Once Sentinel sends a draft, Monica can drive commercial negotiations.

Key questions for the vendor:
- Can they preserve our existing custom exclusions and allow rollout via MDM policy?
- Is there a path to a cheaper 36-month commitment vs 12-month?
- Vulnerability scanner: do we keep unlimited scans or move to sampled scans?

I want to own the product/security requirements; Monica, can you confirm procurement timeline (PO vs amendment) and the earliest we can have a signed agreement? Ben, please flag any immediate red lines from a compliance perspective.

Thanks,
Priyom
Product Manager, Infra Security
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Previous_SOW_2024.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Alex Jones <alex.jones@sentinelshield.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — endpoint stack (MDM / EDR / vuln) — request for SOW and pricing

Hi Priyom (and team),

Thanks for the note — appreciate the context. Attached are two files: SOW_v2.pdf (draft SOW with scope adjustments) and Quote_20261207.xlsx (line-item pricing, 12/24/36 month options). High level: we can keep your existing MDM rollout patterns and preserve exclusions, but the EDR agent retention policy needs a small uplift for 30-day telemetry if you want the extended detection analytics (that’s reflected in the pricing).

Quick clarifications we need from you:
1) Final headcount/hosts to quote (you listed 1,200 hosts in last renewal — still accurate?).
2) Do you want enterprise vuln scanning (full authenticated scans) or keep the current external unauthenticated schedule?

We can offer a 12% discount for a 36-month committed term, or a small onboarding credit if you sign within 30 days. I can also produce a minimal procurement packet for your finance team — SOW + Statement of Work redlines + standard contract + SOC2 report excerpt.

Next steps: I’ll leave the draft SOW and pricing with you. If procurement needs a completed vendor form, send it over and I’ll have our procurement manager complete it.

Cheers,
Alex Jones
Enterprise Accounts — SentinelShield
[Attachment: SOW_v2.pdf (application/pdf)] [Attachment: Quote_20261207.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Jones <alex.jones@sentinelshield.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — endpoint stack (MDM / EDR / vuln) — request for SOW and pricing

Monica / Marissa —

Alex attached a draft SOW and the pricing worksheet. Initial asks below so we can triage internally before pushing vendor for final redlines:
- Confirm hosts count: I verified; target is 1,250 hosts (includes contractor fleet) — please quote on 1,250.
- EDR retention: security to confirm whether 30-day telemetry is required; if not, ask Alex for alternative pricing with 7-day retention.
- Vulnerability scanner: I am inclined to move to authenticated scans for critical infrastructure only (to control cost) — Ben, thoughts?

Procurement note: Monica, do we require a PO up front or can we do a contract amendment referencing the existing master services agreement (MSA)? If PO is required, vendor asked for a completed procurement form (see links). I’ve logged this in SECOPS-482.

Related links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SECOPS-482 (notes + cost modeling)

Priyom

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Jones <alex.jones@sentinelshield.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — endpoint stack (MDM / EDR / vuln) — request for SOW and pricing

Thanks Priyom. Procurement process below — timeline target ~3 weeks if vendor is responsive.

Procurement steps we need from SentinelShield:
- Completed procurement form (company W-9, remit info) — use our vendor portal or return the attached Procurement_Form.pdf.
- Copy of the insurance certificate and SOC2 or equivalent — we can accept a redacted SOC2 report.
- Final SOW with line items (we need separate lines for MDM, EDR, and vuln scanning).
- Confirm invoicing cadence (monthly vs quarterly) and whether fees are seat-based or host-based.

PO vs MSA amendment: since we have an active MSA, we can do a contract amendment referencing the MSA and avoid a full purchase order for this renewal. That will speed signature, but finance needs the final amounts and the payment term (Net30/Net45). If you want the 36-month discount, we’ll need CFO approval for the commit — I can scope that once we have final pricing.

I’ve attached the procurement form for Alex to fill and return. Alex, can you complete and return by EOD Thursday 2026-12-05?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Procurement_Form.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Jones <alex.jones@sentinelshield.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T13:17:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — endpoint stack (MDM / EDR / vuln) — security review items

Quick security notes after a fast pass on the draft SOW:
- SOC2: we need the latest Type II report (redacted ok) and confirmation of the last audit date.
- Telemetry retention: must be configurable per environment; production should have 30 days min for detection, dev/test can be 7 days.
- Agent update controls: we need the ability to disable auto-updates for a 7-day maintenance window on a per-group basis.
- Vulnerability scanner: authenticated scans are ok for critical systems; any authenticated scan that requires credential storage must be proxied via our secrets store — vendor must support env-specific credential rotation.
- Data residency: telemetry for EU-hosted agents must not be routed to US-only analytics endpoints (we have a separate EEA compliance requirement).

If Sentinel can answer these in writing and add the retention/configuration language to the SOW, I’m comfortable moving forward. Otherwise we need an engineered exception.

Ben Carter
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Jones <alex.jones@sentinelshield.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T15:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — endpoint stack (MDM / EDR / vuln) — security review items

Hi all,

Thanks for the detailed notes — appreciate the specificity. Quick replies inline:  
- Hosts: we’ll quote 1,250 hosts.
- Telemetry retention: we can support environment-specific retention. I’ll add language to SOW_v2 and produce an alternate pricing row for 7-day vs 30-day retention.
- Agent updates: supported — we’ll add a clause that allows disabling auto-updates for a configurable window per policy group.
- Authenticated vuln scans: supported; we will document credential proxying and rotation compatibility in the SOW.
- SOC2: attaching a redacted SOC2 Type II excerpt (SOC2_report_stub.pdf) for your records. Full copy can be provided to your security team under an NDA if required.

I’ve attached SOW_final.docx with the retention and agent update language, plus the procurement form completed. If this looks good, I can route to our legal team to accept an MSA amendment and then we can issue a signature packet (DocuSign link attached). Please confirm PO number or finance contact for invoice routing.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben confirms the SOW wording is acceptable.
2) Monica confirms payment terms and whether CFO needs to approve the 36-month commit.
3) Priyom signs off on final scope and we route to legal for MSA amendment.

Best,
Alex Jones
Enterprise Accounts — SentinelShield
[Attachment: SOW_final.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)] [Attachment: SOC2_report_stub.pdf (application/pdf)]
